about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Nanette Diaz Barragán

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: END WAR IN IRAN
statements.title: END WAR IN IRAN
sentences: Mr. Speaker, on Sunday, President Trump went on ``60 Minutes.'' When he spoke about the war with Iran, he said: ``You know, when you call it a war, it's not a war.
If you look at what's happened with Iran in the last 6 months, 5 months, 6 months, we haven't lost one soldier.'' Mr. Speaker, the President's statement is wrong, dead wrong.
Mr. Speaker, 23 American servicemembers have died because of President Trump's war of choice with Iran, and at least 866 have been wounded.
Two Air Force servicemembers also died in October in nonhostile incidents while supporting Iran war operations.
Diesel prices have climbed above $6 a gallon nationwide.
Meanwhile, Trump's oil and gas stocks have grown as much as $35.8 million, and Big Oil is raking in record profits.
House Democrats will continue to fight to end his reckless war of choice in Iran and to bring down the cost of groceries and gas.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PEOPLE ARE DYING IN ICE DETENTION
statements.title: PEOPLE ARE DYING IN ICE DETENTION
sentences: They are people who have lived in our communities for years, yet the administration is stripping away legal protections to detain and deport them.
Look at Haitian families with temporary protected status.

When the Supreme Court allowed ICE to profile people racially during enforcement stops based on their race and their language, Supreme Court Justice Kavanaugh wrote that if you are a U.S. citizen, you are going to be free to go after just a brief encounter.

He is a U.S. citizen who was deported to Mexico after a traffic stop in Texas, even though he repeatedly told the ICE officer he was a U.S. citizen and asked to get the proof of citizenship at his home.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OPPOSING THE ICE BUDGET BILL
statements.title: OPPOSING THE ICE BUDGET BILL
sentences: They are bringing a budget to the floor this week to give ICE and Border Patrol another $70 billion blank check--no guardrails, no oversight, no accountability.
Not a single dollar makes life more affordable for working families.
This is not fiscal responsibility.
I join Justices Elena Kagan, Sonia Sotomayor, and Ketanji Brown Jackson in their dissent in Louisiana v. Callais, a decision that seeks to demolish the Voting Rights Act.
Just last week, the Supreme Court allowed Alabama to eliminate a whole majority Black district, essentially reversing its previous opinions.
When Democrats regain the House, we will work to pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to restore voting protections to guarantee fairness and equal representation in our elections.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION DOJ SETTLEMENT
statements.title: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION DOJ SETTLEMENT
sentences: It is to pay out his friends and January 6 rioters.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICANS ARE PAYING THE PRICE
statements.title: AMERICANS ARE PAYING THE PRICE
sentences: It is billions of your tax dollars to fund a fancy ballroom for Trump and his billionaire buddies, while at the same time giving ICE $70 billion to continue terrorizing our communities.

Trump and Republicans have taxed Americans thousands of dollars a year on everyday items with their tariffs on items like phones, soup, and shoes, and cut billions of dollars in programs that would help make healthcare more accessible.
As costs were already rising, Donald Trump launched us into this reckless war of choice on Iran that has skyrocketed gas prices.
If oil companies are making billions off of a crisis, then working families deserve a return for their money.
They have cut support for electric vehicles, cut funding for public transit, and cut funding for clean energy sources that would give people a choice.
We need to invest in affordable, clean energy of the future so that families aren't stuck riding this roller coaster every time oil prices spike.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
statements.title: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
sentences: Americans are paying more for gasoline this year because of Trump's war of choice against Iran.
Americans have seen the price spike in the last month, and the average household is expected to spend an extra $740 on gas this year because of Trump's war of choice against Iran.
We can thank Republicans and Trump's tariff war for that along with the war on Iran.
Trump's tariffs cost families more than $2,500 extra this year.
At a time when families are struggling to get by, they are proposing massive increases in defense spending and pouring billions of dollars more into wars of choice overseas.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RISING COSTS
statements.title: RISING COSTS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, House Republicans continue to enable Donald Trump's costly and disastrous war of choice against Iran, all while refusing to lift a finger to help working families as their bad policies drain Americans' wallets.
It is Trump's war of choice that is costing American families, and it is his tax through tariffs on American families.
Jessica Hernandez is a driver who transports people with disabilities in a wheelchair-accessible van.
She is working harder, longer, and still falling behind because of Trump's reckless war in Iran.
I also heard from a truck driver who said the rising diesel gas prices have caused the price of delivering goods to go up.
Instead of addressing the rising costs, President Trump has slapped tariffs on many products that enter the United States, and that is a tax on our working families.
Trump's war with Iran is costing Americans billions.

His latest proposed budget calls for cuts to programs like energy assistance and affordable housing that would help Americans get back on their feet but asks for huge increases in military spending instead.
House Democrats are fighting to lower costs and make life affordable for working families. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MASS DEPORTATIONS AND FAMILY SEPARATIONS
statements.title: MASS DEPORTATIONS AND FAMILY SEPARATIONS
sentences: He hadn't gone to the bathroom in 8 days.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PRICES ARE TOO HIGH
statements.title: PRICES ARE TOO HIGH
sentences: The nonpartisan Tax Foundation has said that under the watch of Trump and Republicans, the U.S. has had the largest tax increase as a percent of GDP since 1993 because of tariffs.
These tariffs are a tax on the U.S. and Americans.
Clean energy, like wind and solar paired with battery storage, is the cheapest power we can build.

If we build more of it, we can lower electricity prices, which means American families will be able to turn the heat on in the winter or the AC on during dangerous heat waves, but the Trump administration and Republicans in Congress are doing everything they can to stop clean energy that will help lower costs for the American taxpayer.
The result: higher prices for working families.
House Democrats are fighting for affordable clean energy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
statements.title: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
sentences: Under the Republicans' plan, millions of Americans will not be able to afford health insurance because Republicans don't provide money for Americans to pay for the healthcare under the Affordable Care Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: They can give tax breaks to billionaires.
Mr. Speaker, I oppose the Republican spending bill that makes healthcare more expensive for hardworking Americans.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to reject this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MILLIONAIRES' TAX BREAKS IN BIG, UGLY BILL
statements.title: MILLIONAIRES' TAX BREAKS IN BIG, UGLY BILL
sentences: Now, they are even trying to rebrand their so-called big, beautiful bill with a new name about working families.
Trump and Republicans' big, ugly law makes the cost of healthcare go up and takes away healthcare from working families.
Republicans hand out an average of $80,000 in tax breaks to every millionaire.
Each millionaire tax cut is paid for by taking away insurance from four people.
It means a mom with diabetes may have to skip her insulin or a dad ignores chest pains because he can't afford the ER visit.

While Republicans protect tax breaks for billionaires, Democrats are working to protect affordable coverage, lower prescription drug costs, and expand access to healthcare for working families because in our America, healthcare is not a privilege for the wealthy few.

We are fighting to make sure that if you work hard, you and your family should have healthcare and should be able to afford to see a doctor, fill a prescription, and get the care you need without going bankrupt.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SCOTUS' IMMIGRATION RAIDS ACTION
statements.title: SCOTUS' IMMIGRATION RAIDS ACTION
sentences: This week, six members of the U.S. Supreme Court decided to allow ICE raids in Los Angeles that are rooted in racial profiling.
Six members of the Supreme Court may have turned their backs on equal justice, but Congress cannot.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONDEMNING THE VIOLENT JUNE 2025 RIOTS IN LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA
statements.title: CONDEMNING THE VIOLENT JUNE 2025 RIOTS IN LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA
sentences: I want to remind the American people and everybody that it was local law enforcement that got the situation under control before the National Guard and the Marines showed up.
I know because I was on the phone with the sheriffs and local law enforcement who said, no, they don't need anybody, that the situation was under control.

It falsely paints a picture of widespread chaos across Los Angeles to justify and legitimize Donald Trump's dangerous decision to deploy the National Guard and U.S. Marines on American soil, all without the consent of California's Governor or a request from local leaders and law enforcement.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to this partisan and misleading resolution under consideration.
Mr. Speaker, this resolution ignores those facts to score political points, and I urge a ``no'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OPPOSING PROVIDER TAX RESTRICTIONS IN THE GOP RECONCILIATION BILL
statements.title: OPPOSING PROVIDER TAX RESTRICTIONS IN THE GOP RECONCILIATION BILL
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Senate Republicans are making Donald Trump's big, ugly bill even uglier with steeper cuts to Medicaid that will leave more kids, parents, and seniors without healthcare.
This is all so they can reward their billionaire donors with even bigger tax breaks.
This bill would deeply cut Medicaid and hurt our most vulnerable.
If you do, you stand to lose $38.9 billion and kick up to 600,000 people off Medicaid.
Many States, including Republican States, lose tens of billions of dollars in Medicaid funding.
Are you, the American people, going to just get over losing your healthcare so that a billionaire can buy a bigger yacht?
Right now, States use a variety of tools to help pay for their share of Medicaid, which is the health insurance program for low-income families, children, seniors, and people with disabilities.
That is when hospitals or health plans agree to pay a small tax to keep Medicaid running.
It puts new restrictions on States that expanded Medicaid to low-income people, saying they can't collect as much from hospitals or health insurance companies as they do now.
It means the Federal Government would be telling States that you can't use the money you have depended on for years to keep Medicaid going.
I have no doubt that the plan Republicans come up with will slash Medicaid and devastate hospitals to fund their tax breaks.
I am not going to hold my breath because Republicans have already caved last month and voted to kick millions of people off Medicaid.
Republicans should stand up for hospitals, stand up for patients, and stand up for the millions of Americans who count on Medicaid every day. ____________________
Mr. Speaker, I urge Republicans in Congress to join us to do the right thing and oppose this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING SNAP FROM BUDGET CUTS
statements.title: PROTECTING SNAP FROM BUDGET CUTS
sentences: It is all to pay for tax breaks for billionaires and big corporations.
Tylynn was homeless and lost custody of her children because she simply could not afford to feed them.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today to oppose the cruel cuts Republicans want to make to SNAP, the food assistance program.
We will not stand by silently while Americans are pushed into hunger.
Mr. Speaker, I urge the Senate to reject these cuts.
I urge my House Republican colleagues to grow a spine to fight so Americans don't go hungry. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: KEEP YOUR HANDS OFF MEDICAID
statements.title: KEEP YOUR HANDS OFF MEDICAID
sentences: Today, the Congressional Budget Office released an analysis that Republicans' proposals that they are considering would slash Medicaid spending that would lead to millions of people losing healthcare coverage.
Behind every Medicaid recipient is a person whose life depends on it.
I am healthy today because Medicaid stood by me.
Medicaid makes independence possible.
Any threat to Medicaid is a threat to our lives.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PUT HARDWORKING AMERICAN FAMILIES FIRST
statements.title: PUT HARDWORKING AMERICAN FAMILIES FIRST
sentences: We have watched markets around the world plummet, prices spike, and our trading partners hit back with tariffs on American goods that are attacks on the American people.
Trump's reckless trade war has only begun to squeeze the American people.
Exports at the port complex have also plummeted as retaliatory tariffs by other countries hit agriculture and manufactured goods.
Trump and his billionaire donors won't feel any of it.
They don't feel it when the cost of a can of soup is up a couple of dollars because of tariffs on aluminum.

They don't feel it when the cost of our constituents' kids' shirts go up $10 apiece because there is a tariff on the clothes they buy or when the cost of their next oil change goes up $20 because the parts and filters are imported.

This month, Republicans plan to pass the new tax cuts for their billionaire donors and big corporations, and their giveaway to the wealthy will be paid for by cuts to Medicaid, basically healthcare, and food stamps that hardworking American families rely on.

The idea that the U.S. Government can deport children who are U.S. citizens or send immigrants to dangerous foreign prisons without a court hearing and then claim the government bears no responsibility should terrify every one of us.
Mr. Speaker, I will not stand silent while families are ripped apart and while the Constitution is trampled on.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "CALIFORNIA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ENGINE POLLUTION CO
statements.title: PROVIDING CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "CALIFORNIA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ENGINE POLLUTION CONTROL STANDARDS; HEAVY-DUTY...
sentences: I rise for the young people who have the right to a future free from polluted air, climate disasters, and preventable health crises.
House Republicans are trying to overturn EPA's approval of California's clean air waivers, a move that would strip California's ability to protect its people from dangerous air pollution.
Thousands of people in California and around the country wrote in support of these clean air protections that Republicans want to rip away.

Please allow California to enforce stronger clean air protections.'' Tia Triplett from Los Angeles wrote to EPA that heavy truck pollution threatens the health of her community, and she urges stronger protections.
Our constituents don't need more diesel trucks idling near our homes, pumping smog into our lungs.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to stand with our communities and protect their right to clean air.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OPPOSITION TO H.J. RES. 24 AND H.J. RES. 75
statements.title: OPPOSITION TO H.J. RES. 24 AND H.J. RES. 75
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I oppose H.J. Res. 24 and H.J. Res. 75 because these resolutions roll back common-sense energy efficiency standards for commercial refrigerators, freezers, and walk-in coolers-- standards that were rigorously developed by the Department of Energy (DOE) to save businesses money while cutting energy waste.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING EDUCATION TRANSPARENCY AND ENDING ROGUE REGIMES ENGAGING IN NEFARIOUS TRANSACTIONS ACT
statements.title: DEFENDING EDUCATION TRANSPARENCY AND ENDING ROGUE REGIMES ENGAGING IN NEFARIOUS TRANSACTIONS ACT
sentences: While protecting research from foreign influence is important, this bill goes too far, sweeping in respected organizations like the United Nations and the World Health Organization.
Mr. Chair, I oppose H.R. 1048, the DETERRENT Act, because it imposes unnecessary, overly broad reporting mandates on universities under the pretense of national security.
That is why I oppose it, along with major higher education groups and research institutions. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOUSE REPUBLICANS ARE COMPLICIT IN PRIVACY VIOLATIONS
statements.title: HOUSE REPUBLICANS ARE COMPLICIT IN PRIVACY VIOLATIONS
sentences: House Republicans have allowed billionaire Elon Musk and his gang of thieves to enter the U.S. Treasury Department, fire the people entrusted with secret, private information about Americans, and give them that access.

Madam Speaker, this billionaire, his interns, and his young workers have complete access to your Social Security number, your bank account number, your name, your address, your Medicare payments, your tax refunds, and your veterans benefits.
It is to have more money to make sure House Republicans can give to their billionaire friends, and tax cuts.
Madam Speaker, imagine going to your doctor and you are told you cannot be seen because Elon Musk has cut off Medicaid payments to your State.
Elon Musk and House Republicans want to steal it from the American people to give tax breaks to billionaires and to get investments in our communities.
